note: BLM campground on a one-way loop in pines beside the Wild & Scenic Trinity River at Douglas City, with a small river beach inside the campground. The host gives out the shower code. --Claude
summary: Douglas City (BLM Redding): $20 confirmed; 23 sites (stored 24), no hookups, flush toilets, showers, water; 15 RV sites reservable on rec.gov, 2/3/5-8 first-come; 14-night max; closes 1 Nov, reopens April. Riverview confirmed (rec.gov Riverfront tags are 40-90 m back behind a riparian treeline). Pin 285 m off -> 40.6478,-122.9534.

WATERFRONT riverview confirmed (stored value not --AWH): rec.gov tags sites 17, 18, 19, 21, 22, 23, 24 'Riverfront', but measured on Esri imagery they sit ~40 m (17), ~55-65 m (18, 19), ~65-80 m (21-23) and ~90 m (24) from the Trinity's edge, behind a continuous riparian tree strip under pine canopy; the river itself is ~40-50 m wide (river-size).
